claims.statement: For QSR1 in the evidence, every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME finite program (exhaustive n<2^20, short certified-log R=ceil(sqrt(xplus)), m=ceil(T0/R) counted/hash/window table program otherwise) recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. On EVERY branch its T=O(n^(93/2)2^(sqrt(n)sqrt(log2 n)+3sqrt(log2 n))), jointly with all resource bounds and clean law. All outside constants are absolute. Source filters, failed attempts, full addressing/monitor generation, deterministic preprocessing and terminal cleanup are charged. Resource representatives apply for n>=2 with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Its exact numerical growth index is 1/2. Classical storage is n^(2+o(1)), not exactly quadratic.

Source filters, failed attempts, full addressing/monitor generation, deterministic preprocessing and terminal cleanup are charged. For the SAME QSR1 finite program in the evidence files, for every N>=2 and s, n=ceil(log2 N) and Q the ACTUAL number of source copies acquired including filters and discarded trees, the guaranteed malformed-copy count is tau(n,Q)=0. Every acquired copy must be an independent ideal coset state. Unconditional entire-secret success is greater than 2/3 and all four resource bounds hold jointly on every branch including source/work aborts. No positive-corruption guarantee or maximum-tolerance impossibility is asserted.
